# Pokemon Investigations: Turnabout at Sea

![Screeshots](https://i.ibb.co/6R3nDbFX/collage.jpg)

Entry for TARC 3.

This is a crossover between Pokémon, Ace Attorney Investigations and Detective Conan.

Play as Miles Edgeworth and solve a mystery aboard a cruise ship.
Find clues and connect them to deduce evidence.

Seek out the truth and bring the murderer to justice.
